fullText.simplified:
二、我是个好妖

    时间过得真快，春去秋来，离小男孩救下小白蛇，已经过去一千年了。
    这里是青城山。太阳已经下山了，一条小小的山路上，两个书生正向山下走去。他们一个穿白衣，一个穿蓝衣。
    白衣书生走得很急，他说：“天快黑了，我们走快点儿吧！”
    蓝衣书生笑着说：“你担心什么？太阳下去了，还有月亮，能看清路的。”
    “我不是担心看不清楚路，我是害怕天黑以后在这大山里遇到不干净的东西。”
    “不干净的东西？你是说妖怪？”蓝衣书生笑得更厉害了，“你怎么这么胆小？哪有妖怪？”
    “别说了！”白衣书生说，“还是快走吧！”
    说着，白衣书生加快了脚步。两人的脚步声和蓝衣书生的笑声在山路上回响。在他们身后，一双眼睛正看着他们。那双眼睛不像人的，而是一条大青蛇的。
    白衣书生感觉不对，回头看了一眼，脸变白了。蓝衣书生见他样子奇怪，也回头看了一眼。这一眼，吓得他都不会说话了：“天啊……妖……妖怪！”
    大青蛇向他们爬过来，又长又粗的蛇身前面有一个头，却不是蛇头，而是一个女子的头。
    “快跑！”白衣书生大叫一声，拉着蓝衣书生飞跑起来。
    青蛇跟在他们后面，边爬边笑，笑声很奇怪，是个年轻女子的笑声。
    就在这时，山路上突然出现一道白色闪电，直接向青蛇劈来。青蛇飞起来，没被闪电劈到，但那两个书生已经跑远了。
    “是谁坏我的好事？！”青蛇生气地叫道。
    树林里走出一个年轻美丽的姑娘，一身白衣，黑色长发，双眼明亮。
    青蛇看了姑娘一会儿，动了动身体，粗大的蛇身变成了细瘦的人身。现在青蛇也是个好看的姑娘了。
    青蛇问：“胆子真大，你不怕我吃了你吗？”
    白衣姑娘一点儿也不害怕，她说：“你不能害人。”
    “我是妖，杀人、吃人都是正常的事，有什么不能的？”
    “你可以做个好妖，不害人。”
    青蛇笑了：“如果我没有看错的话，你也是妖。难道你不吃人、不害人，是个好妖？”
    白衣姑娘说：“我不吃人，也不害人。”
    “那你真是个没用的妖。”
    “不，我比你厉害。”
    “我不信。你又没和我打过，怎么知道我没你厉害？”
    “那你现在出手吧。”白衣姑娘笑着说。
fullText.traditional:
二、我是個好妖

    時間過得真快，春去秋來，離小男孩救下小白蛇，已經過去一千年了。
    這裡是青城山。太陽已經下山了，一條小小的山路上，兩個書生正向山下走去。他們一個穿白衣，一個穿藍衣。
    白衣書生走得很急，他說：“天快黑了，我們走快點兒吧！”
    藍衣書生笑著說：“你擔心什麼？太陽下去了，還有月亮，能看清路的。”
    “我不是擔心看不清楚路，我是害怕天黑以後在這大山裡遇到不乾淨的東西。”
    “不乾淨的東西？你是說妖怪？”藍衣書生笑得更厲害了，“你怎麼這麼膽小？哪有妖怪？”
    “別說了！”白衣書生說，“還是快走吧！”
    說著，白衣書生加快了腳步。兩人的腳步聲和藍衣書生的笑聲在山路上迴響。在他們身後，一雙眼睛正看著他們。那雙眼睛不像人的，而是一條大青蛇的。
    白衣書生感覺不對，回頭看了一眼，臉變白了。藍衣書生見他樣子奇怪，也回頭看了一眼。這一眼，嚇得他都不會說話了：“天啊……妖……妖怪！”
    大青蛇向他們爬過來，又長又粗的蛇身前面有一個頭，卻不是蛇頭，而是一個女子的頭。
    “快跑！”白衣書生大叫一聲，拉著藍衣書生飛跑起來。
    青蛇跟在他們後面，邊爬邊笑，笑聲很奇怪，是個年輕女子的笑聲。
    就在這時，山路上突然出現一道白色閃電，直接向青蛇劈來。青蛇飛起來，沒被閃電劈到，但那兩個書生已經跑遠了。
    “是誰壞我的好事？！”青蛇生氣地叫道。
    樹林裡走出一個年輕美麗的姑娘，一身白衣，黑色長髮，雙眼明亮。
    青蛇看了姑娘一會兒，動了動身體，粗大的蛇身變成了細瘦的人身。現在青蛇也是個好看的姑娘了。
    青蛇問：“膽子真大，你不怕我吃了你嗎？”
    白衣姑娘一點兒也不害怕，她說：“你不能害人。”
    “我是妖，殺人、吃人都是正常的事，有什麼不能的？”
    “你可以做個好妖，不害人。”
    青蛇笑了：“如果我沒有看錯的話，你也是妖。難道你不吃人、不害人，是個好妖？”
    白衣姑娘說：“我不吃人，也不害人。”
    “那你真是個沒用的妖。”
    “不，我比你厲害。”
    “我不信。你又沒和我打過，怎麼知道我沒你厲害？”
    “那你現在出手吧。”白衣姑娘笑著說。

sentences.pinyin: nà nǐ zhēn shi ge méi yòng de yāo
sentences.english: “Then you’re such a useless demon.”

sentences.simplified: “不，我比你厉害。”
sentences.traditional: “不，我比你厲害。”
sentences.pinyin: bù wǒ bǐ nǐ lì hai
sentences.english: “No, I‘m more formidable than you.”

sentences.simplified: “我不信。你又没和我打过，怎么知道我没你厉害？”
sentences.traditional: “我不信。你又沒和我打過，怎麼知道我沒你厲害？”
sentences.pinyin: wǒ bú xìn nǐ yòu méi hé wǒ dǎ guò zěn me zhī dào wǒ méi nǐ lì hai
sentences.english: “I don’t believe you. You haven’t fought me before, so how do you know I’m not as formidable as you?”

sentences.simplified: “那你现在出手吧。”白衣姑娘笑着说。
sentences.traditional: “那你現在出手吧。”白衣姑娘笑著說。
sentences.pinyin: nà nǐ xiàn zài chū shǒu ba bái yī gū niang xiào zhe shuō
sentences.english: “Then go ahead and make your move now,” the girl in white said with a smile.

sentence_translations: 2. I Am a Good Demon
Time flew by quickly.
The seasons came and went, and it had already been a thousand years since the little boy saved the little white snake.
This is Mount Qingcheng. The sun had already set. On a small mountain path, two scholars were walking down the mountain.
One was wearing white, and the other was wearing blue.
The scholar in white walked hurriedly and said, “It’s getting dark soon, let’s walk faster!”
The scholar in blue smiled and said, “What are you worried about?
The sun has set, but there’s still the moon. We’ll be able to see the path clearly.”
“I’m not worried about not being able to see the path clearly.
I’m afraid of encountering unclean things on this big mountain after dark.”
“Unclean things? Do you mean demons?”
The scholar in blue laughed even harder: “You’re this timid? What demons?”
“Stop it!” the scholar in white said, “Let’s hurry and leave!”
As he was saying this, the scholar in white quickened his pace.
The footsteps of the two of them and the laughter of the scholar in blue echoed on the mountain path.
Behind them, there was a pair of eyes watching them.
That pair of eyes did not seem like they belonged to a human, but rather belonged to a big green snake.
The scholar in white sensed that something was off. He turned around to take a look, and his face turned pale.
The scholar in blue saw his strange expression and also turned around to take a look.
With that glance, he was so scared that he couldn’t speak: “Oh my god … a … a demon!”
The big green snake crawled towards them.
In front of its long, thick body was a head. But instead of a snake head, it was the head of a woman.
“Quick, run!” the scholar in white shouted loudly. He tugged on the scholar in blue and began running away quickly.
The green snake followed behind them, laughing as it crawled.
The laughter was very strange. It was the laughter of a young woman.
Just at that moment, a bolt of white lightning suddenly appeared on the mountain path, striking directly at the green snake.
The green snake flew up and was not struck by the lightning, but the two scholars had already run far away.
“Who ruined my grand plans?!” the green snake shouted angrily.
Out of the forest walked a young, beautiful girl.
She was dressed head to toe in white and had long, black hair and a pair of bright eyes.
The green snake looked at the girl for a while, and then moved her body a bit.
The thick snake body transformed into a slender human body. Now, the green snake was also a beautiful girl.
The green snake asked, “What bravery. Aren’t you afraid that I’ll eat you?”
The girl in white was not afraid at all. She said, “You can’t harm people.”
“I am a demon. Killing people and eating people are normal things. What do you mean I can’t?”
“You can be a good demon and not harm people.”
The green snake laughed: “If I’m not mistaken, you are also a demon.”
Don’t tell me you don’t eat people and don’t harm people, and that you’re a good demon?”
The girl in white said, “I don’t eat people, nor do I harm them.”
“Then you’re such a useless demon.”
“No, I‘m more formidable than you.”
“I don’t believe you. You haven’t fought me before, so how do you know I’m not as formidable as you?”
“Then go ahead and make your move now,” the girl in white said with a smile.
